calls_semantics: candidate dependency inventory; conditional execution is authoritative in references/call-graph.md and never bypasses the human review gate

entries.name: groundtruth-run-check
entries.trigger: A ground-truth run needs its preflight before launch or its evidence check after the run.
entries.validation: Before launch, verify the checkout tuple, mode predicate, inputs, and fresh paths; after the run, verify every check of the run and record PASS only when all pass.

entries.name: groundtruth-run
entries.trigger: A passed preflight permits a vLLM-BS ground-truth run in one declared mode.
entries.validation: Write the run manifest before launch, keep the launcher alive to the terminal status, then hand every run tag to the post-run check.

entries.name: simulator-run
entries.trigger: A frozen Frontier case and cell are ready to run after the semantic check.
inputs: Frontier settings file of the current generation
KV block count of the cell's clean run
entries.validation: Run one non-dummy command with an explicit settings file into a fresh label directory and verify the exit code, the log, and every declared metric.

entries.name: semantic-alignment-check
entries.trigger: Frontier and vLLM values may look equal while their topology, scheduling, routing, or metric meaning differs.
inputs: Frontier settings file and effective settings
entries.validation: Evaluate every setting row and the MoE routing audit with source anchors, a status, and an explicit next action.

entries.name: semantic-alignment-repair
entries.trigger: A decided semantic alignment table names a concrete Frontier setting or mapping mismatch.
entries.validation: Record the decision before the code change, run the regression set, then obtain fresh semantic evidence.

entries.name: e2e-metrics-gap
entries.trigger: Clean Frontier and vLLM request rows need the five independent E2E metric decisions for a cell.
inputs: cell entry in the scenario matrix
entries.validation: Normalize the rows, apply the cell's gate kind over every admissible reference run, and report absolute values beside each relative error.

entries.name: dispatch-align-trace
entries.trigger: Client dispatch or frontend routing delay changes which requests a DP lane or step sees.
inputs: passing clean runs with dispatch and route stamps
outputs: route_delay record in the run receipt and the scenario matrix
entries.validation: Draw member delays from the measured pool with recorded seeds, change only arrival times, and verify ids, token counts, and trace hashes.

entries.name: workflow-gap-analysis
entries.trigger: Request queueing, step membership, batch formation, or DP x PP lane behavior differs and the control flow must be explained.
entries.validation: Compare the first formal batch, all declared phases, step classes per request, and lane modes with source anchors.

entries.name: workflow-repair
entries.trigger: A decided workflow analysis identifies a reproducible Frontier control-flow difference.
entries.validation: Apply the smallest Frontier control-flow change, run the regression set and the affected cells, and refresh workflow evidence.

entries.name: op-gap-analysis
entries.trigger: Matched step classes differ in device price and need a per-operator or per-kernel comparison.
inputs: clean, op_timing, and kernel_timing runs of one trace
entries.validation: Normalize identity internally, require the first and three aligned batches, separate measurement cost, then calculate signed and absolute gaps.

entries.name: op-supplement
entries.trigger: Operator analysis or coverage lacks a phase, shape, grid point, kernel gap, or device generation.
inputs: op gap status or coverage gaps
entries.validation: Run the plan, merge losslessly into a new table set, and verify hashes and the completion marker before any Frontier run uses it.

entries.name: op-repair
entries.trigger: A decided operator analysis proves a scoped predictor, mapping, or pricing correction.
entries.validation: Apply one scoped Frontier change, run the regression set and the affected cells, then regenerate op and E2E evidence.

entries.name: residual-lane-classification
entries.trigger: The error budget leaves a part in PP, collective, KV transfer, or M2N transfer time that needs a source classification.
entries.validation: Classify PP, collective, KV/M2N, mixed, or unclear residuals with native scope and numeric evidence.

entries.name: residual-repair
entries.trigger: A decided residual classification identifies a PP, collective, or KV/M2N correction.
entries.validation: Select one declared lane, apply the smallest Frontier change, run the regression set, and refresh residual and E2E evidence.

entries.name: cpu-overhead-analysis
entries.trigger: The error budget attributes part of a failing gated metric to host time.
entries.validation: Attribute host phases per step class from admitted probe runs and classify each part without an independent CPU threshold.

entries.name: cpu-overhead-supplement
entries.trigger: CPU analysis reports missing or unadmitted host rows and the user approved the measurement work.
inputs: CPU-probe runs with their paired clean runs
entries.validation: Admit each probe run by its rule, produce the tables with the repository producer, record input and output hashes, and return to CPU analysis.

entries.name: cpu-overhead-repair
entries.trigger: A decided CPU analysis proves a scoped Frontier host-side pricing correction.
entries.validation: Apply one scoped Frontier change, run the regression set and clean E2E, then refresh all applicable gates.

entries.name: parity-run
entries.trigger: A user needs a reproducible Frontier and vLLM-BS case, or new cells, collected with aligned semantics.
entries.validation: Call the semantic check, the ground-truth preflight, runs and post-run checks, then the simulator runs, in call-graph order.

entries.name: error-analysis
entries.trigger: A completed case needs a read-only explanation of its numerical error source.
entries.validation: Run the E2E gate, the semantic check, the error budget, and the analyses the budget selects, then classify every attributed part.

entries.name: error-correction
entries.trigger: Decided analysis artifacts identify corrections that must be applied, rechecked, and republished.
entries.validation: Run one decided domain change at a time, obtain fresh analysis, finish with the E2E gate, and republish the readings.
